text:
Maya: quick a11y pass on the Model Activity dashboard this morning. Found a few separate nits around keyboard flow, focus visibility, and screen reader noise. Dropping notes here so eng/design can triage.
Diego: thanks Maya. high-level list?
Maya: TLDR: (1) skip-to-main-controls link is present but after use keyboard focus doesn't return correctly on subsequent tabs; (2) filter flyout traps focus but lacks aria-modal and focus-management on close; (3) status pill disabled state uses 60% gray on hover -> contrast < 3:1; (4) progress announcer reads every percent update while streaming.
Priya: good list. can you add repro and tiny fixes we can ship quickly?
Maya: repro 1 (skip link): Console -> Models -> Activity. Tab to top bar, press Enter on "Skip to main controls". Focus jumps to control bar but we replace the skiplink element during animation. On second attempt the link is not reachable because DOM node was recreated with no focusable attribute. Quick fix: don't recreate node; toggle class `.visually-hidden` instead and keep `tabindex=0` stable.
Diego: makes sense. we'll keep DOM stable. add `aria-controls` pointing to `main-controls` so JAWS users get context.
Maya: repro 2 (filter flyout): when opening the filters the flyout backdrop captures focus but we never set `aria-modal="true"` on the dialog. On close focus returns to body. Fix: set `role="dialog" aria-modal="true"` and move focus into the first filter control on open; on close return focus to the trigger button.
Sam: note: ensure focus trapping ignores inert elements (we use CSS `inert` in other places). Also add an accessible label: `aria-labelledby` referencing the flyout heading.
Maya: repro 3 (contrast): disabled chip CSS: `.chip--disabled:hover { background: #f2f2f2; color: #666666; }` contrast = 2.6:1 on hover. Options: lighten bg less or switch to `#ffffff` text on hover. Proposed CSS: ```css .chip--disabled:hover { background: #e0e0e0; color: #111111; font-weight:600; } ```
Priya: please include before/after color swatches in the PR. We should aim for >= 4.5:1 for smaller text.
Maya: repro 4 (progress announcer): streaming progress is in `div[aria-live=polite]` and updates micro-percent every 200ms. Screen readers announce each tick. Proposed: debounce announcements and only announce at 25% increments or on state change (started/paused/complete). Example JS: ```js const announce = debounce((msg) => liveRegion.textContent = msg, 600); announce("Streaming started");```
Diego: question: do we still need live updates for visually impaired users? maybe a summary indicator suffices.
Sam: for continuous output use a visible visual progress bar; for SR users we should only announce meaningful milestones. Also use `aria-atomic=true` so the full phrase is read.
accessibility-bot: auto-audit: https://redwood-infra/audits/2246000123 â€” Contrast: FAIL (disabled chip hover), Focus-visible: FAIL (compact rows missing outline), ARIA: WARN (missing aria-modal on filter flyout).
Maya: prioritization suggestion: 1) stabilize skiplink DOM (low lift) 2) fix flyout focus trap + aria-modal (medium) 3) debounce progress announcements (medium) 4) chip contrast (low).
Priya: schedule wise: skiplink + chip change in a small CSS/JS PR this sprint. Flyout + announcer in next sprint, Sam to pair on SR tests.
Diego: I'll open PR for skiplink + chip today. include unit test for skiplink focus persistence.
Sam: will do NVDA/VoiceOver pass after PR – aiming Wed. Also add an e2e keyboard test that tabs through the control bar twice to ensure skiplink remains reachable.
Maya: thanks everyone. adding notes to backlog card: https://redwood-infra/board/431 and tagging design QA. :sparkles:
